title: The Lamp Hall (stock Lumenary interior, SNES register)
_note: Stock Lumenary hall interior (Tinderwick/Brisa, Pearlmoor/Reyl, any later hall without a bespoke cue). 90 BPM 4/4, D minor -> F major bridge, 24 bars. A (8, Dm, organ processional melody) -> A' (8, cadences home on D) -> B (8, F major brass chorale, turns on A major to lead back). Choir pad carries real chords, processional root-fifth half-note bass, a timpani (tom) roll leading every 4-bar phrase, one bell glint per phrase end. Bar 1 opens on the awed hit (crash + timpani) then settles: the 'hit then settle' shape. Reverent, never battle-busy.
